name: dropwatch
description: Dropwatch earns Twitch Drops for you in the background and claims each reward as soon as it's earned. **What it does** - Picks which campaign to watch, and moves to another channel when a stream goes offline - Collects channel points and watch-streak bonuses on your favourite channels - Lists anything that needs you, such as a game account to link - Web dashboard for priorities, skipped games, pinned campaigns and history, phone included - Optional notifications to Discord, Telegram, ntfy, Slack, Pushover, Gotify or any webhook **Getting started** Open the WebUI, choose a page password, then sign in to Twitch with a one-time code. One Twitch account per container.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Where Dropwatch keeps its database (Twitch sign-in, lists, history) and cached images.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Port for the Dropwatch web UI.

variables.name: Allowed host names
variables.description: Only needed to open Dropwatch through a public domain name, such as a reverse proxy (dropwatch.example.com). Comma-separated. IP addresses and local names like tower or tower.local always work.

variables.name: Reverse proxy address
variables.description: Only behind a reverse proxy: its address, so the login lockout sees each visitor's own address.
